## Validation

## Checklist

- [ ] The change remains public, brand-neutral, and self-hostable.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and important failure paths.
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass, or the exception is explained above.
- [ ] Public package, adapter, publish, smoke, or browser checks were run where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, local state, generated deployment output, media, or production data are included.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility manifests are updated where required.
- [ ] Required downstream pin or contract work is identified without silently changing downstream repositories.
- [ ] No live-provider call, package publication, deployment, paid operation, or production mutation was performed without explicit authorization.
